name: Parking Space / Driveway Rental

yield.notes: Highly location-dependent. Urban spots near transit/stadiums earn more.

flags: HOA or lease may prohibit subletting parking

prerequisites: Own or lease a driveway, garage, or parking spot
startup_checklist: Check HOA/lease agreement for restrictions on subletting parking
Research comparable rates in your area on SpotHero/Neighbor.com
List on SpotHero, Neighbor.com, and/or ParkingForMe with clear photos
Set competitive price slightly below comparable spots to get first bookings
After first 3 bookings, raise price 10-20% if demand holds
failure_modes: No demand in your specific location
kill_criteria: Zero bookings after 60 days at competitive pricing
HOA or landlord prohibits the activity
sources_note: Income ranges from SpotHero marketplace data and community reports.
